race.description: Rotary Club Of West Wollongong Hcp (Bm64)
race.comment: ALL GUCCI (5) again gave away a considerable start over 1500m at Newcastle last time before hitting the line well to finish fourth. Winning chance who will be winding up strongly. CABBUCIO (9) also wound up strongly last time out to finish a close second over 1400m at this track when resuming after a break. Fitter and is sure to measure up with that run under her belt. CANNY QUEEN (1) progressed nicely last time out to score by a nose over 1400m at this track. Finds a suitable race and can play a major role again. SMART CRY (14) found one better last time out over 1600m at Gosford, beaten just a nose. Worth including again.
